name: GRN-related frontotemporal lobar degeneration with Tdp43 inclusions
description: A frontotemporal dementia characterized by variable phenotypic expression typically including social, behavioral, or language deterioration, rather than memory or motor deficits and the presence of TARDBP-positive inclusions that has material basis in mutation in the GRN gene on chromosome 17q21.31.
